description.en: Credential for Codex local and programmatic workflows. This is not a Platform API key, Workspace Agent token, or Codex App Server auth secret.
description.ja: Codex local/programmatic workflow 用の credential。Platform API key、Workspace Agent token、Codex App Server auth secret ではありません。

metadata.risk_reason: A configured Codex token can enable local/programmatic coding workflows and must not be reused as App Server auth.

description.en: Configure Codex App Server as a Tools & MCP tool source and automation endpoint. Remote endpoints require separate App Server auth.
description.ja: Codex App Server を Tools & MCP の tool source / automation endpoint として設定します。remote endpoint には別の App Server auth が必要です。

metadata.risk_reason: Codex App Server can enable high-impact automation through approval and execution capabilities.
